# iNaturalist terms of use and community guidelines

Third-party documents, vendored as a record of the terms BirdView complies with.
**Not covered by BirdView's Apache 2.0 license, and not openly licensed.** The
documents are © iNaturalist; BirdView claims no rights in them and grants none.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Files** | `terms.html`, `community-guidelines.html`, `machine-generated-content.html` |
| **Origin** | <https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/terms>, <https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/community+guidelines>,
and <https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/machine_generated_content> |
| **Version** | Retrieved 2026-08-09 |
| **Owner** | iNaturalist |
| **License** | None granted. All rights reserved by iNaturalist. |
| **Modifications** | `<script>`, `<style>` and `<link>` elements removed, so the copies are inert. Nothing else is changed: the text is never reformatted, reworded or partially quoted. |
| **Used for** | Nothing at runtime. BirdView's requirements quote these documents, and the copies let a reader check every quotation against the exact text it came from. |

Retrieval details and the SHA-256 each file is checked against are recorded once, in
[spec/sources/inat-terms/PROVENANCE.md](../../spec/sources/inat-terms/PROVENANCE.md), and verified
by `spec/check/pins.py`.
